name: 308. Streamed frames: the final frame carries the non-streamed usage, a vendor error before the first frame, frames forwarded on arrival (streamed frames timing)
description: Contract C10 BF22 (TXE-6522), local fixture regression with no live provider calls. Start provider-error-fixture.mjs and an isolated gateway using provider-error-fixture.config.json; enable providerErrorFixture=1 (README: Streamed frames timing). Error cases: the fixture answers upstream-503 and upstream-429 with that status before any frame, on chat with stream: true and on speech with stream_format: "sse"; the gateway must answer with the vendor's status and a JSON error, never 200 followed by an error frame. Gap cases: upstream-gapped writes three marker frames 600ms apart; the fixture's /__probe/stream-gaps sends the request to the gateway and times each SSE event on the clock the fixture wrote the frames with, so each marker must reach the client before the vendor writes the next one, and the gaps must survive. The usage-bearing final frame (chat's last data frame, speech.audio.done) is asserted too. Usage rows (BF21): upstream-usage-extended reports web search calls, cost and cost_in_usd_ticks; the non-streamed chat response, the final frame of a chat stream (both routes) and of a text-completion stream, and response.completed of a Responses stream served by the chat fallback (parasail) must all carry them. Each case runs on the native route and the OpenAI-compatible route.
